pt-BR.name: Nove de Paus
pt-BR.intro: Ferido e enfaixado, um homem se apoia no cajado diante de uma cerca de bastões. Cansaço, cautela e a persistência de quem já enfrentou muito e ainda não desiste.

bandaged-head.title: A Cabeça Enfaixada
bandaged-head.description: A atadura revela batalhas passadas: a experiência que deixa marcas, mas também ensina. Cada ferida é uma lição que o torna mais atento.

leaning-wand.title: O Cajado de Apoio
leaning-wand.description: Ele se apoia no bastão que já foi arma: a força que antes servia ao ataque agora sustenta o descanso. Resistir também é saber usar o que se tem.

wand-fence.title: A Cerca de Cajados
wand-fence.description: Oito hastes enfileiradas atrás dele formam uma barreira: as defesas que construiu, uma a uma, ao longo do caminho. Elas protegem, mas também limitam.

wary-gaze.title: O Olhar Vigilante
wary-gaze.description: Ele olha de lado, atento a uma ameaça que pode ou não vir: a desconfiança de quem já foi surpreendido e agora mede cada passo.

en-US.name: Nine of Wands
en-US.intro: Wounded and bandaged, a man leans on his staff before a fence of wands. Weariness, caution and the persistence of someone who has faced much and still has not given up.

bandaged-head.title: The Bandaged Head
bandaged-head.description: The bandage reveals past battles: experience that leaves marks but also teaches. Each wound is a lesson that makes him more alert.

leaning-wand.title: The Supporting Wand
leaning-wand.description: He leans on a staff that was once a weapon: strength that once served attack now supports rest. Endurance is also knowing how to use what you have.

wand-fence.title: The Fence of Wands
wand-fence.description: Eight staves lined up behind him form a barrier: the defenses he built one by one along the way. They protect, but they also confine.

wary-gaze.title: The Wary Gaze
wary-gaze.description: He glances sideways, watching for a threat that may or may not come: the distrust of one who has been surprised before and now measures every step.

ja.name: ワンドの9
ja.intro: 傷つき包帯を巻いた男が、杖の柵の前で杖にもたれています。疲れ、警戒、そして多くを乗り越えてなお諦めない粘り強さです。

bandaged-head.title: 包帯を巻いた頭
bandaged-head.description: 包帯は過去の戦いを物語ります。傷を残しながらも教えてくれる経験。傷のひとつひとつが、彼をより注意深くする教訓です。

leaning-wand.title: 支えの杖
leaning-wand.description: 彼はかつて武器だった杖にもたれます。攻撃に使われた力が、今は休息を支えています。耐えるとは、手元にあるものを活かすことでもあります。

wand-fence.title: 杖の柵
wand-fence.description: 背後に並ぶ八本の杖が障壁を作ります。道すがら一つずつ築いた防御です。守ってくれる一方で、行動を制限もします。

wary-gaze.title: 警戒のまなざし
wary-gaze.description: 彼は来るかどうかも分からない脅威を横目で見張ります。かつて不意を突かれ、今は一歩ごとに慎重な者の疑いです。

he.name: תשע של מטות
he.intro: פצוע ועטוף תחבושת, אדם נשען על מטהו מול גדר מטות. עייפות, זהירות והתמדה של מי שכבר עבר הרבה ועדיין לא מוותר.

bandaged-head.title: הראש החבוש
bandaged-head.description: התחבושת חושפת קרבות שעברו: ניסיון שמשאיר סימנים אך גם מלמד. כל פצע הוא לקח שהופך אותו לקשוב יותר.

leaning-wand.title: המטה התומך
leaning-wand.description: הוא נשען על מקל שפעם היה נשק: הכוח ששימש לתקיפה תומך עכשיו במנוחה. עמידה היא גם לדעת להשתמש במה שיש.

wand-fence.title: גדר המטות
wand-fence.description: שמונה מטות בשורה מאחוריו יוצרים מחסום: ההגנות שבנה אחת אחת לאורך הדרך. הן מגינות, אך גם מגבילות.

wary-gaze.title: המבט הדרוך
wary-gaze.description: הוא מציץ הצידה, דרוך לאיום שאולי יגיע ואולי לא: חשדנותו של מי שכבר הופתע בעבר וכעת מודד כל צעד.
